en: Match the carved stones. Wake the temple.
Inspired by The Treasures of Montezuma (Alawar Entertainment, 2009)
Deep in the jungle stands a temple no one has entered for centuries.
Its treasures are guarded by carved stones that only move in threes.
Match the stones, fill every quota before time runs out, and the temple's secrets are yours.
